name: Set Trap
description:
Choose one:

  • Drop. You drop and conceal one of your traps in an adjacent space. Roll Stealth to set that trap's Difficulty. When a creature enters the trap's space, it rolls Awareness against the Difficulty.

  • Throw. You throw a trap to an unoccupied space within short range. Roll Craft to set that trap's Difficulty. When a creature enters the trap's space, it rolls Dexterity against the Difficulty.

Either way, if the creature fails its check, the trap springs. Choose two of your trap effects (defined in the Trapper trait). On a loss, just choose one Trap effect.

Describe how you set your trap.
